conversion_rules: Pydantic error locations map deterministically to exact JSON Pointer paths
top-level syntax failures use $ and typed rule codes
object_required, multiple_candidates, malformed_json and unknown_field remain distinct
observed values are represented by shape/type/count/hash only
no finding may collapse into pathless natural-language summary

ptr3_compatibility.method: project rule_code, field_path, invariant_id, value_type and structural_shape into existing DiagnosticDomainFindingV1

bounded_repair_sufficiency: finding identity plus parent/revision/dependency hints forms a CAS-bound repair target
